mapper.sql: id, user_id, agent_code, agent_name, agent_level, parent_id, ancestor_ids, level_depth, invite_code, qr_code_url, phone, real_name, id_card, bank_name, bank_account, status, source_type, import_batch_id, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_agent WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dms_agent WHERE id IN
#{id}
SELECT FROM dms_agent agent WHERE agent.invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 )
SELECT agent.* FROM dms_agent agent WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 ) ORDER BY agent.create_time DESC

SELECT agent.id AS agentId, agent.agent_name AS agentName, agent.agent_level AS agentLevel, CASE #{rankType} WHEN 1 THEN COALESCE(performance.rangePersonal, 0) WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(recruits.rangeNew, 0) ELSE COALESCE(performance.rangeTeam, 0) END AS performanceValue, CASE #{rankType} WHEN 1 THEN COALESCE(performance.totalPersonal, 0) WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(recruits.totalNew, 0) ELSE COALESCE(performance.totalTeam, 0) END AS totalPerformance, CASE #{rankType} WHEN 1 THEN COALESCE(performance.monthPersonal, 0) WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(recruits.monthNew, 0) ELSE COALESCE(performance.monthTeam, 0) END AS currentMonthPerformance, COALESCE(recruits.totalNew, 0) AS totalNewAgentCount, COALESCE(recruits.monthNew, 0) AS currentMonthNewAgentCount FROM dms_agent agent LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_agent_id, SUM(CASE WHEN relation_level = 0 AND order_time >= #{rangeStart} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rangePersonal, SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= #{rangeStart} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rangeTeam, SUM(CASE WHEN relation_level = 0 THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalPersonal, SUM(performance_amount) AS totalTeam, SUM(CASE WHEN relation_level = 0 AND order_time >= #{monthStart} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END) AS monthPersonal, SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= #{monthStart} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END) AS monthTeam FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE status = 1 AND order_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY target_agent_id ) performance ON performance.target_agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT relation.parent_agent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN child.create_time >= #{rangeStart} THEN child.id END) AS rangeNew, COUNT(DISTINCT child.id) AS totalNew, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN child.create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN child.id END) AS monthNew FROM dms_agent_relation relation INNER JOIN dms_agent child ON child.id = relation.agent_id WHERE relation.is_valid = 1 AND child.create_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY relation.parent_agent_id ) recruits ON recruits.parent_agent_id = agent.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 ) ORDER BY performanceValue DESC, agent.id ASC

SELECT agent.* FROM dms_agent agent WHERE agent.parent_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 ) ORDER BY agent.create_time ASC
SELECT FROM dms_agent WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT agent.* FROM dms_agent agent WHERE agent.status = #{status} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 ) ORDER BY agent.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, COALESCE(performance.current_month_performance, 0) AS currentMonthPerformance, COALESCE(account.total_commission, 0) AS totalCommission, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_agent_relation relation_row WHERE relation_row.parent_agent_id = a.id AND relation_row.is_valid = 1) AS teamMemberCount FROM dms_agent a LEFT JOIN dms_agent_account account ON account.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_agent_id, SUM(performance_amount) AS current_month_performance FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE status = 1 AND order_time >= #{monthStart} GROUP BY target_agent_id ) performance ON performance.target_agent_id = a.id WHERE a.id IN
#{agentId}

SELECT a.* FROM dms_agent a LEFT JOIN dms_shop_member m ON m.user_id = a.user_id
AND COALESCE(m.system_account, 0) = 0
AND a.status = #{status}
AND ( a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.agent_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.login_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_agent (user_id, agent_code, agent_name, agent_level, parent_id, ancestor_ids, level_depth, invite_code, qr_code_url, phone, real_name, id_card, bank_name, bank_account, status, source_type, import_batch_id, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{agentLevel}, #{parentId}, #{ancestorIds}, #{levelDepth}, #{inviteCode}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{phone}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{importBatchId}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_agent SET agent_name = #{agentName}, agent_level = #{agentLevel}, parent_id = #{parentId}, ancestor_ids = #{ancestorIds}, level_depth = #{levelDepth}, qr_code_url = #{qrCodeUrl}, phone = #{phone}, real_name = #{realName}, id_card = #{idCard}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_account = #{bankAccount}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
